Name: XNB Loader
Author: Entoarox
Description:
[b]Install steps[/b]
[color=#ff0000]
XNB Loader is now deprecated.[/color] It was last updated for the 1.3 game version, but it's no longer in development and won't be updated to the 1.4 version. You should migrate to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] instead. Many authors have already migrated their mods, and there's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods#Alternatives_using_Content_Patcher]a list of unofficial conversions[/url] for those who haven't.

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Install Entoarox Framework[/url].[/b]
[*]Unzip the download into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Once installed, you can add XNB mods in the [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley\Mods\XNBLoader\ModContent[/font] folder.
[/list]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.3.32 through 1.3.36
[*]Linux, Mac, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]See also[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Entoarox/StardewMods/blob/master/XnbLoader/RELEASE-NOTES.md#release-notes]Release notes[/url]

[*][url=https://www.patreon.com/entoarox]Consider supporting Entoarox on Patreon[/url]
[/list]
